name: Registration Parameters 3
definition: Information related to registration of securities.

CertificationDateTime.name: Certification Date Time
CertificationDateTime.definition: Date/time at which the certificates in the deposit were validated by the agent.

RegistrarAccount.name: Registrar Account
RegistrarAccount.definition: Account at the registrar where financial instruments are registered.

CertificateNumber.name: Certificate Number
CertificateNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a certificate assigned by the issuer.
